# Statement map

Each numbered statement of Sections 1 to 4 of the paper, with its Lean declarations or "not formalized", and the commands that check it with their recorded outputs; the rows "Section" are claims of the text without a number. The formalization proves the lemmas in the cases that the proof of Theorem 1 uses, mostly at $`p = 73`$, as the column Lean 4 says. The second implementation maps each of its checks to its script, output and time in `code/impl2/README.md`.

The table is written from the paper by `sh paper/statement-map.sh --write`, after `latexmk -pdf main.tex` in `paper/`: the source carries next to each label a command that prints nothing, with the declarations and the checks of that statement. The script fails when a numbered statement other than a question has no entry, when the text names a declaration of the namespace `KeithZanello` that the table does not, when a file, a check of `code/impl2/rerun.sh` or a recorded output it names does not exist, or when the last part of a declaration name is not defined in exactly one file of `KZ73/`; `sh paper/statement-map.sh --lean --check` also checks each full name with `#check` in Lean, on the built package (3 s).
